definitions.explanation: A small hard piece of something, like a grain of rice or sand.
A small round drop of liquid.

examples.japanese: この{米|こめ}は{粒|つぶ}が{大|おお}きい。
{汗|あせ}の{粒|つぶ}が{額|ひたい}に{浮|う}かんでいた。
examples.english: Beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.

examples.japanese: {一粒|ひとつぶ}も{残|のこ}さず{食|た}べなさい。
examples.english: Eat every single grain without leaving any.

examples.japanese: {砂|すな}の{粒|つぶ}が{靴|くつ}の{中|なか}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: Grains of sand got into my shoes.

examples.japanese: このイチゴは{粒|つぶ}が{大|おお}きくて{甘|あま}い。
examples.english: These strawberries are large and sweet.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{粒|つぶ}が{窓|まど}に{当|あ}たる。
{涙|なみだ}の{粒|つぶ}が{頬|ほお}を{伝|つた}って{落|お}ちた。
{朝露|あさつゆ}の{粒|つぶ}が{葉|は}の{上|うえ}で{光|ひか}っていた。
examples.english: Drops of morning dew were glistening on the leaves.

examples.japanese: {大粒|おおつぶ}の{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}して、あっという{間|ま}にびしょ{濡|ぬ}れになった。
examples.english: Large drops of rain started falling, and I was soaked in no time.

notes:
{粒|つぶ} refers to small, often spherical particles or grains.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一粒|ひとつぶ} (one grain/drop)
- {粒|つぶ}ぞろい (uniformly high quality, lit: grains well-matched)
- {米粒|こめつぶ} (grain of rice)
- {涙|なみだ}の{粒|つぶ} (teardrops)
- {汗|あせ}の{粒|つぶ} (beads of sweat)

COUNTING:
- {一粒|ひとつぶ}、{二粒|ふたつぶ}、{三粒|みつぶ}... (one grain, two grains, three grains...)
- Also counted with {粒|つぶ} as a counter: 1{粒|つぶ}、2{粒|つぶ}...
